findings.claim: In GetWebAssets, after acquiring the write lock the code does not re-check whether entryPointAssetsCache was already populated by another goroutine. Concurrent cold-cache callers therefore each re-read and re-parse assets-manifest.json redundantly and overwrite the cache.

verifier.reason: In pkg/api/webassets/webassets.go:40-49, GetWebAssets checks entryPointAssetsCache under RLock (lines 41-45) and then acquires the write lock at line 48 without re-checking entryPointAssetsCache. Consequently, lines 59-70 unconditionally re-read and re-parse assets-manifest.json and overwrite entryPointAssetsCache for every concurrent cold-cache caller that queued on the write lock.

coverage: pooled issues; severity and verdict are placeholders
